 By GMA News Published November 3, 2026 12:31pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: Hulu/YouTube “The Remarried Empress,” starring Shin Mina, Ju Ji Hoon, Lee Jong Suk, and Lee Seyoung, will premiere on Disney+ and Hulu on Tuesday, a day earlier than originally scheduled.
 According to Deadline , the announcement was made during a press conference in Seoul, South Korea, as a special thank-you to fans for their support.
 The series will launch with its first four episodes.
 “The Remarried Empress” was originally a Korean webtoon that followed an empress navigating love, betrayal, and power after her husband divorced her to marry another woman.
 The story follows Empress Navier and Emperor Sovieshu, whose marriage falls apart after the emperor falls in love with another woman.
 Navier agrees to their divorce on the condition that she be allowed to marry Crown Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.
 —Carby Rose Basina/CDC, GMA News
